name: halo-dropzone
title: Halo Dropzone
description: A frosted dark panel with a dashed edge and a wash of pink, blue and green light inside it, asking you to drop or browse for files. Underneath, each queued file shows a thumbnail, name, size, progress bar and remove cross.
use: Users need to attach several files at once and watch each one finish in place.
avoid: The dark frosted fill and coloured glow rely on a dark backdrop and will wash out on white pages.
a11y: The zone is a focusable label with an aria-label, Enter and Space open the picker, progress bars carry roles, and motion is reduced when asked. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A wide rounded dropzone with a faint dashed border and a pink, blue and green glow inside. A small circular upload arrow sits over white instruction text and a grey hint line. Below are two near-black rows, each with a white page thumbnail, a thin progress bar and a cross.
behaves: Files can be dropped onto the panel or chosen through the browser picker, which also opens from Enter or Space. Rows slide in, their thin bars fill with a pink-to-blue gradient, then turn green with a tick at completion; clicking a cross removes that row.
customise: Labels, icon, format hint, multiple, accept, disabled, translucent and success timing are props. The upload rows and their progress are separate components you feed with items.
weight: moderate: Several blurred gradient blobs animate forever, plus a frame-loop rim trail on interaction.
demo: Two seeded uploads, q3-board-deck.pdf at 2.3 MB and launch-hero@2x.png at 1.4 MB.
polishWhy: Tidy rows and a rich but readable glow; the demo's progress is simulated rather than real.
